name: WeatherHistogram
observations: Vanilla JS SPA for weather visualization
Vite + JSDoc + Vitest + Playwright
Tiled canvas rendering with histogram, minimap, stickman layers
PWA with service worker (cache-first for static assets)
Version: 1.11.0+
GitHub Pages hosted

Memory graph rebuilt 2026-05-28: 56 entities (48 production JS modules + 7 architecture docs + 1 project) with 113 import relations reflecting actual module dependency graph. All stale entities (116) and relations (~120) from prior sessions deleted.

name: architecture.data-flow
observations: app.js orchestrator calls init functions → WeatherFetcher.fetchWeatherData() → WeatherService.getWeatherData() (Open-Meteo API) → DataProcessor.processData() → mutates state → render() loop reads state and draws to canvas
User scroll → render() reads scrollLeft → offscreen buffer check → drawImage or full redraw
User taps location → MapSelector → GeoService.searchLocation → state update → re-fetch weather data
Favorites: FavoritesModal → FavoritesService → StorageService (IndexedDB)

name: architecture.canvas-layers
observations: Single visible canvas (#chart-canvas) for the main chart
All drawing happens in render() — never draw to tile canvases outside this function
Three layers stacked in #chart-area: chart-wrapper (scrollable histogram), minimap-wrapper (overview strip), fixed-overlay-canvas (scrubber line)
Offscreen canvas buffer (3x viewport width) for scroll performance — single drawImage blit ~0.1ms

name: architecture.tiling
observations: TILE_WIDTH=1440px (720px on mobile <600px)
Canvas width = TILE_WIDTH, clipped to viewport
render() loop renders only visible tiles + 1 buffer on each side
Overlap 1px between tiles for Mali-G76 GPU seam prevention

name: architecture.minimap
observations: MINIMAP_HEIGHT=80px
MinimapRenderer class with past/future modes — auto-switches based on scroll position relative to current time index
Draws compressed chart + viewport overlay rectangle as scroll indicator

name: architecture.key-constants
observations: CHART_HEIGHT=250, MINIMAP_HEIGHT=80, TILE_WIDTH=1440, PIXELS_PER_MM=10, CACHE_DURATION=300000ms (5 min), DEFAULT_COORDS={lat:40.4168, lon:-3.7038} (Madrid)
PIXELS_PER_HOUR: 60px desktop > 600px, 50px mobile <= 600px — stored on state, not CONFIG
getDPR() caps at 2 for performance

name: architecture.ui-components
observations: BottomSheet: swipe-to-dismiss overlay system (z-index: 1000+), dynamic stacking
TopPanel: current conditions (temp, weather icon, AQI, wind, UV, pollen, alerts)
DailyCards: horizontal scrollable daily forecast cards
YearInPixels: yearly grid widget for mood/temp/health tracking
MapSelector: Leaflet map modal for location search
FavoritesModal: CRUD for saved locations
ChangelogModal: version history in bottom sheet
SpfModal: sun protection calculator
PullToRefresh: gesture-based data refresh
TooltipManager: positioned tooltip system
ScrollIndicator: chart scroll position bar
AqiRadar: radar chart for AQI pollutants
PollenRadar: hexagonal radar for 6 pollen types

name: architecture.services
observations: WeatherService: raw Open-Meteo API client (forecast + air-quality endpoints)
DataProcessor: transforms raw API data → state.hourlyData/dailyData → daily cards → persist history
StorageService: IndexedDB abstraction (userPreferences, historyData) with localStorage fallback — singleton pattern
GeoService: geocoding (Open-Meteo) + reverse geocoding (Nominatim) with 50ms request queue
FavoritesService: CRUD for persisted favorite locations — singleton pattern
AqiManager: AQI/pollen/UV classification with localized colors and thresholds
MockData: synthetic weather data generator for offline/demo mode
